title: St. Paul's Epistles to the Colossians and to Philemon
author: J.B. Lightfoot
source_edition: First edition (Macmillan and Co., London, 1875). PG transcription by the Distributed Proofreaders team.
notes: J.B. Lightfoot (1828-1889) was Bishop of Durham and one of the Cambridge Triumvirate of NT scholars. First edition 1875; US public domain. Greek and Latin apparatus text preserved verbatim. Verse blocks separated by 72-char dash lines in PG transcription; duplicate headings (same verse appearing in multiple blocks) are merged into single entries.
